subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS-only: Berlin criteria were an inclusion requirement. Obesity: no BMI reported; tidal volume on ideal weight but no BMI data, so unclear. Timing: grouping occurred 'after the hemodynamics was stable, and upon fluid resuscitation and definitive operation treatment' — interval from intubation/ICU admission not quantified, so unclear. PTP target: end-expiratory transpulmonary pressure kept at smallest positive number within 0–10 cm H2O using absolute Pes subtraction.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlap: single-centre Chinese trial (Xiamen Third Hospital), no trial registration number, no shared authors or centres with any cluster in COHORTS.md (epvent1/epvent2, mannheim_boesing, mgh_lung_rescue, angers all differ in institution, country, and population).
unclear_items: citation.year: document is an uncorrected galley proof headed 2018 (Technology and Health Care -1 (2018) 1–11); final published year may be 2019 per COHORTS.md note on wang_2018.
design.n_centers: single institution implied by one affiliation but never stated explicitly.
design.randomised: randomisation stated ('random number table') but no allocation concealment or ratio reported.
population.n_vasopressors: only a percentage (44.4%) reported for the whole cohort; the count of patients is not printed.
outcomes: Table 3 Lac row for ARDSNet group at 72 h reads '11 ± 0.3', which appears to be a typographical error (likely 1.1 ± 0.3); recorded verbatim as 11.
outcomes: Table 5 IL-6/IL-8 rows lack a sixth-day column; the text says 'after treating for 72 hours', so the second IL timepoint is coded as day 3/72 h.
feasibility.n_placement_attempted/n_placement_successful: derived from the statement that all 23 reported patients had catheters inserted; no explicit placement success count given.
eligibility.adults_18_plus: explicit age range 18–80 stated, so coded yes without inference.
design.enrolment_start/enrolment_end: not reported; received 15 June 2018, accepted 7 October 2018 are manuscript dates only.
extraction_flags.general_notes: Galley proof with multiple typographical artefacts (e.g. interleaved watermark text, '11 ± 0.3' lactate value, Pm listed in Table 2 caption but no Pm row present). No mortality, ventilator-free days, or barotrauma outcomes reported for the 23 randomised patients; the 8 deaths mentioned occurred among the 36 screened patients before enrolment. No balloon-related complications reported and no negative safety statement, so complications_explicitly_none is null.
